name: BNASTRA
recent: Binastra 近期获得价值 RM303.8 million 的智能仓库建筑合约，并有多笔大股东（Prudential、Eastspring）的股权变动申报。此外，董事经理 Datuk Tan Kak Seng 在公开市场出售了 4000 万股。
notable: 获得价值 RM303.8 million 的智能仓库建筑合约，为 PTT Synergy 在巴生建设自动化仓库设施。
董事经理 Datuk Tan Kak Seng 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日以每股 RM2.80 出售 4000 万股（3.654%）。
Prudential 及 Eastspring 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 董事经理 Datuk Tan Kak Seng 出售 4000 万股，占已发行股份 3.654%。
董事及主要股东在闭门期内有交易意向的申报。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 RM658.4 million，环比增长 8.7%，同比增长 65.9%；净利为 RM50.6 million，环比增长 30.9%，同比增长 78.1%；净利率为 7.7%，高于上一季度的 6.4%。

recent_en: Binastra recently secured a RM303.8 million smart warehouse construction contract and saw multiple substantial shareholder (Prudential, Eastspring) interest change filings. Managing Director Datuk Tan Kak Seng also disposed of 40 million shares in the open market.
notable_en: Secured a RM303.8 million smart warehouse construction contract to build automated warehouse facilities for PTT Synergy in Klang.
Managing Director Datuk Tan Kak Seng disposed of 40 million shares (3.654%) at RM2.80 per share on 20 Oct 2026.
Prudential and Eastspring made multiple substantial shareholder interest change filings between October and November.
risks_en: Managing Director Datuk Tan Kak Seng disposed of 40 million shares, representing 3.654% of issued shares.
Directors and principal officers filed intentions to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For 3Q FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was RM658.4 million, up 8.7% QoQ and 65.9% YoY; net profit was RM50.6 million, up 30.9% QoQ and 78.1% YoY; net margin was 7.7%, higher than 6.4% in the previous quarter.
